summary: Applies transforms to CHOP channel groups interpreted as XYZ positions or vectors, with optional normalization and second-input transform control.
key_concepts: Transform XYZ CHOP applies transform data to input channel groups interpreted as XYZ positions or vectors.
Position mode applies translation, while vector mode ignores translation and applies only orientation/scale style effects.
The first input is grouped by channel names ending in `x`, `y`, and `z`.
The second input supplies transforms using Transform CHOP-supported transform formats.
The second-input transform and Transform page settings are combined before being applied to the XYZ data.
Multi-sample CHOP inputs allow many points or vectors to be transformed at once.

key_params.name: input0type
key_params.note: Interpret input groups as positions or vectors

key_params.name: unmatchedchans
key_params.note: Warn, ignore, or delete unmatched channels

common_gotchas: Vector mode ignores translation; use position mode when translation should affect values.
Input channels must be grouped with expected x, y, z suffixes for reliable conversion.
Second-input transforms should follow Transform CHOP channel conventions.
